BLOCKS BI-PF-1295 (disposition needs full inventory)
conflict_findings: Shares config/store-registry.json with BI-PF-1293 — ADR owner must not edit fields concurrently
duplication_findings: Existing store-registry.json — extend not recreate
Individual *store.py modules already encode store behavior; avoid duplicating in registry
from.rationale: Extends existing registry to cover enterprise metadata required by residency/retention work.
assumptions: All current stores are discoverable via existing *store.py modules and registry
Retention/recovery tiers defined in ADR
risks: Incomplete inventory may cause gate false positives
Registry schema churn if ADR evolves
evidence: core/artifact_store.py, asset_store.py, forge_store.py, pipeline_store.py, project_store.py are registered stores
missing_info: Sensitivity classification per store requires data-owner input
Retention tier values for each store

context_review.reason: Registry and stores exist; classification decisions need human input.

consolidation_proposal.title: EDP-02: Store & data-flow inventory + extend store-registry.json (sensitivity, tenant_scope, backend, retention, recovery_tier, migration_status) + completeness gate
consolidation_proposal.body: Part of EPIC BI-PF-1292. Source: docs/Product_Forge_Enterprise_Performance_Security_DB_Storage_Roadmap.md. Phase item (see epic). Language rule L1 = Go; must pass scripts/dev/language_rule_review.py.
acceptance_criteria: Every store entry has owner, kind, scope, concern, visibility, sensitivity, tenant_scope, backend, retention, recovery_tier, migration_status, rebuild_proc.
A wired_audit/registry check fails closed on an unclassified or ownerless store.
Data-flow register (beyond primary DBs) captured: object versions, WAL/PITR, replicas, caches, queues, logs, traces, model calls, exports.
ADR document committed covering storage layers, backends, and data-flow decisions
Develop commit SHA pinned and recorded
L1 Go rule passes language_rule_review.py
The 11 interfaces are declared with explicit optional capabilities (versioning/lock/conditional-write/KMS/signed-URL/multipart).
A conformance suite runs against any adapter (starting with WorkerGrid's store as reference).
No domain module depends on a concrete provider.
